title: MotionBricks: modular motion generation and smart primitives

claims.text: The project describes a real-time generative backbone trained on over 350,000 motion clips. Smart primitives expose navigation and object interaction controls, with claimed zero-shot transfer to downstream tasks.
The project links a public runtime with Warp, Newton and TensorRT backends, pretrained SOMA and Unitree G1 models, an ONNX exporter and interactive authoring tools.

limitations: Real-time and zero-shot descriptions are publisher claims rather than measurements made here.
The visual demonstration was not evaluated.
gaps: Latency, hardware suitability and deployment licensing require their own checks against the linked release.
